ambient_events: A price is chalked up, looked at, and chalked down again.
Somebody buys nothing at all and stays twenty minutes and leaves happier.
The locked case is opened, something is taken out, and the case is locked again.
description: A shopfront made of four different shopfronts, none of which came from the same building, and a shutter that rolls up into a housing off a truck. Everything about it's salvage and none of it's slapdash. The stock board by the door is written in a careful hand and priced in three currencies.
name: Rindle's
